stemMd: A cube stack has two depth rows. At x = 0, 1, 2, the front-row heights are 1, 4, 2 and the back-row heights are 3, 2, 1. In a front orthographic silhouette, what heights appear from left to right? In the view, increasing x runs from left to right.
explanationMd: At each horizontal position, the silhouette reaches the tallest column along the viewing ray. The pairwise maxima are max(1,3), max(4,2), max(2,1), giving three, four, two. Depth-separated columns are not vertically stacked.

distractorRationale.e: This adds heights of separate depth columns rather than projecting them.
distractorRationale.b: The taller rear column at the left remains visible.
distractorRationale.c: The front row can extend above the rear row.
distractorRationale.a: The silhouette uses maximum, not minimum, heights.
